{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QvUkf1oiiDyDZxt8eQecVT","type":"tool_result","content":"=== cmd/ddkstat/main.go\n     1\t// Command ddkstat reports on Drydock's LLM execution log.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// The reporting pipeline lives in internal/cli. main only hands the arguments to cli.Run and exits\n     4\t// with its code; it is the only package in this module that may call os.Exit.\n     5\tpackage main\n     6\t\n     7\timport (\n     8\t\t\"os\"\n     9\t\n    10\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n    11\t)\n    12\t\n    13\tfunc main() {\n    14\t\tos.Exit(cli.Run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr))\n    15\t}\n=== cmd/ddkstat/layout_test.go\n     1\tpackage main\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"fmt\"\n     5\t\t\"os\"\n     6\t\t\"strings\"\n     7\t\t\"testing\"\n     8\t)\n     9\t\n    10\t// moduleRoot is the application root, two directories above this package.\n    11\tconst moduleRoot = \"../..\"\n    12\t\n    13\tfunc TestGoModDeclaresModuleAndGoVersion(t *testing.T) {\n    14\t\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.mod\")\n    15\t\tif err != nil {\n    16\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"read go.mod: %v\", err)\n    17\t\t}\n    18\t\tvar module, goVersion string\n    19\t\tvar requires int\n    20\t\tfor _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), \"\\n\") {\n    21\t\t\tfields := strings.Fields(line)\n    22\t\t\tif len(fields) == 0 {\n    23\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    24\t\t\t}\n    25\t\t\tswitch fields[0] {\n    26\t\t\tcase \"module\":\n    27\t\t\t\tmodule = fields[1]\n    28\t\t\tcase \"go\":\n    29\t\t\t\tgoVersion = fields[1]\n    30\t\t\tcase \"require\":\n    31\t\t\t\trequires++\n    32\t\t\t}\n    33\t\t}\n    34\t\tif module != \"ddkstat\" {\n    35\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"module = %q, want %q\", module, \"ddkstat\")\n    36\t\t}\n    37\t\tvar major, minor int\n    38\t\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(goVersion, \"%d.%d\", &major, &minor); err != nil {\n    39\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"go directive %q is not major.minor: %v\", goVersion, err)\n    40\t\t}\n    41\t\tif major < 1 || (major == 1 && minor < 22) {\n    42\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"go directive = %q, want 1.22 or newer\", goVersion)\n    43\t\t}\n    44\t\tif requires != 0 {\n    45\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"found %d require directives, want none\", requires)\n    46\t\t}\n    47\t}\n    48\t\n    49\tfunc TestLayoutDirectoriesExist(t *testing.T) {\n    50\t\tfor _, dir := range []string{\"cmd/ddkstat\", \"internal\", \"bin\"} {\n    51\t\t\tinfo, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/\" + dir)\n    52\t\t\tif err != nil {\n    53\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stat %s: %v\", dir, err)\n    54\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    55\t\t\t}\n    56\t\t\tif !info.IsDir() {\n    57\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n    58\t\t\t}\n    59\t\t}\n    60\t}\n    61\t\n    62\tfunc TestNoVendorOrDependencySums(t *testing.T) {\n    63\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/vendor\"); err == nil {\n    64\t\t\tt.Error(\"vendor directory exists, want none\")\n    65\t\t}\n    66\t\tsum, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.sum\")\n    67\t\tif err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(sum)) != \"\" {\n    68\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"go.sum is not empty: %q\", sum)\n    69\t\t}\n    70\t}\n=== internal/cli/args.go\n     1\t// Package cli parses and validates ddkstat invocations.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// ParseArgs performs no I/O and never exits the process.\n     4\tpackage cli\n     5\t\n     6\timport (\n     7\t\t\"fmt\"\n     8\t\t\"strings\"\n     9\t\t\"time\"\n    10\t)\n    11\t\n    12\t// Options is a validated ddkstat invocation.\n    13\ttype Options struct {\n    14\t\tReport  string\n    15\t\tTarget  string\n    16\t\tSince   string\n    17\t\tUntil   string\n    18\t\tLogPath string\n    19\t}\n    20\t\n    21\t// UsageError reports an invocation that does not match the ddkstat command line.\n    22\ttype UsageError struct {\n    23\t\tMsg string\n    24\t}\n    25\t\n    26\tfunc (e *UsageError) Error() string { return e.Msg }\n    27\t\n    28\tfunc usageErrorf(format string, args ...any) error {\n    29\t\treturn &UsageError{Msg: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)}\n    30\t}\n    31\t\n    32\tvar knownReports = map[string]bool{\n    33\t\t\"summary\":  true,\n    34\t\t\"commands\": true,\n    35\t\t\"targets\":  true,\n    36\t\t\"models\":   true,\n    37\t\t\"daily\":    true,\n    38\t\t\"failures\": true,\n    39\t}\n    40\t\n    41\t// checkDate requires value to be a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD. Parsing alone is not\n    42\t// enough: time.Parse accepts shapes such as 2026-1-5, so the value must also round-trip exactly.\n    43\tfunc checkDate(name, value string) error {\n    44\t\tparsed, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value)\n    45\t\tif err != nil || parsed.Format(dateLayout) != value {\n    46\t\t\treturn usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, got %q\", name, value)\n    47\t\t}\n    48\t\treturn nil\n    49\t}\n    50\t\n    51\tconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n    52\t\n    53\t// ParseArgs parses the arguments that follow the program name into Options. The order is fixed:\n    54\t// the report name, then any --target, --since or --until options, then exactly one log path.\n    55\t// Every failure is a *UsageError.\n    56\tfunc ParseArgs(args []string) (Options, error) {\n    57\t\tif len(args) == 0 {\n    58\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"missing report name\")\n    59\t\t}\n    60\t\tif !knownReports[args[0]] {\n    61\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown report %q\", args[0])\n    62\t\t}\n    63\t\topts := Options{Report: args[0]}\n    64\t\n    65\t\ti := 1\n    66\t\tfor ; i < len(args) && strings.HasPrefix(args[i], \"--\"); i += 2 {\n    67\t\t\tname := args[i]\n    68\t\t\tswitch name {\n    69\t\t\tcase \"--target\", \"--since\", \"--until\":\n    70\t\t\tdefault:\n    71\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown option %q\", name)\n    72\t\t\t}\n    73\t\t\tif i+1 >= len(args) {\n    74\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a value\", name)\n    75\t\t\t}\n    76\t\t\tvalue := args[i+1]\n    77\t\t\tswitch name {\n    78\t\t\tcase \"--target\":\n    79\t\t\t\topts.Target = value\n    80\t\t\tcase \"--since\":\n    81\t\t\t\tif err := checkDate(name, value); err != nil {\n    82\t\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, err\n    83\t\t\t\t}\n    84\t\t\t\topts.Since = value\n    85\t\t\tcase \"--until\":\n    86\t\t\t\tif err := checkDate(name, value); err != nil {\n    87\t\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, err\n    88\t\t\t\t}\n    89\t\t\t\topts.Until = value\n    90\t\t\t}\n    91\t\t}\n    92\t\n    93\t\tpositional := args[i:]\n    94\t\tswitch len(positional) {\n    95\t\tcase 0:\n    96\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"missing log path\")\n    97\t\tcase 1:\n    98\t\t\topts.LogPath = positional[0]\n    99\t\t\treturn opts, nil\n   100\t\tdefault:\n   101\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unexpected argument %q\", positional[1])\n   102\t\t}\n   103\t}\n=== internal/cli/run.go\n     1\tpackage cli\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"bytes\"\n     5\t\t\"fmt\"\n     6\t\t\"io\"\n     7\t\t\"os\"\n     8\t\n     9\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/filter\"\n    10\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n    11\t)\n    12\t\n    13\t// ReportWriter writes one report for records already narrowed by the filters. skipped is the\n    14\t// whole-file count of lines that logread did not keep.\n    15\ttype ReportWriter func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error\n    16\t\n    17\t// writers maps a report name to the writer that a report story registered for it.\n    18\tvar writers = map[string]ReportWriter{}\n    19\t\n    20\t// Register makes fn the writer for the report called name. Each report story calls it once from\n    21\t// its own package, so Run never imports a report package.\n    22\tfunc Register(name string, fn ReportWriter) {\n    23\t\twriters[name] = fn\n    24\t}\n    25\t\n    26\t// Run executes one ddkstat invocation. args are the arguments that follow the program name. It\n    27\t// returns the process exit code: 0 on success, 1 when the log cannot be read or a report writer\n    28\t// fails, and 2 on a usage error. Run never calls os.Exit; only cmd/ddkstat does.\n    29\t//\n    30\t// Report output is buffered and written to stdout only when the writer succeeds. Diagnostics go to\n    31\t// stderr, and skipped log lines never change the exit code.\n    32\tfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n    33\t\topts, err := ParseArgs(args)\n    34\t\tif err != nil {\n    35\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"usage: ddkstat {summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures} [--target NAME] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] LOG\\n\")\n    36\t\t\treturn 2\n    37\t\t}\n    38\t\n    39\t\tf, err := os.Open(opts.LogPath)\n    40\t\tif err != nil {\n    41\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot open log %s: %v\\n\", opts.LogPath, err)\n    42\t\t\treturn 1\n    43\t\t}\n    44\t\tdefer f.Close()\n    45\t\n    46\t\tres, err := logread.Read(f, stderr)\n    47\t\tif err != nil {\n    48\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot read log %s: %v\\n\", opts.LogPath, err)\n    49\t\t\treturn 1\n    50\t\t}\n    51\t\n    52\t\trecords := filter.ByDateRange(filter.ByTarget(res.Records, opts.Target), opts.Since, opts.Until)\n    53\t\n    54\t\twrite, ok := writers[opts.Report]\n    55\t\tif !ok {\n    56\t\t\treturn 0\n    57\t\t}\n    58\t\n    59\t\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n    60\t\tif err := write(&buf, records, res.Skipped); err != nil {\n    61\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot write %s report: %v\\n\", opts.Report, err)\n    62\t\t\treturn 1\n    63\t\t}\n    64\t\tif _, err := buf.WriteTo(stdout); err != nil {\n    65\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot write report to stdout: %v\\n\", err)\n    66\t\t\treturn 1\n    67\t\t}\n    68\t\treturn 0\n    69\t}\n=== internal/cli/run_test.go\n     1\tpackage cli_test\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"bytes\"\n     5\t\t\"errors\"\n     6\t\t\"io\"\n     7\t\t\"os\"\n     8\t\t\"path/filepath\"\n     9\t\t\"reflect\"\n    10\t\t\"strings\"\n    11\t\t\"testing\"\n    12\t\n    13\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n    14\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n    15\t)\n    16\t\n    17\t// logLine returns one valid JSON Lines record with the given identifier, start date and target.\n    18\tfunc logLine(id, date, target string) string {\n    19\t\treturn `{\"execution_id\":\"` + id + `\",\"started_at\":\"` + date + `T02:38:41.904Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n    20\t\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"` + target + `\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"},` +\n    21\t\t\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":1,\"cached_input_tokens\":2,` +\n    22\t\t\t`\"output_tokens\":3,\"cost_usd\":0.5,\"elapsed_ms\":4}}}`\n    23\t}\n    24\t\n    25\t// writeLog writes lines to a fresh file under t.TempDir and returns its path.\n    26\tfunc writeLog(t *testing.T, lines ...string) string {\n    27\t\tt.Helper()\n    28\t\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"log.jsonl\")\n    29\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.Join(lines, \"\\n\")+\"\\n\"), 0o644); err != nil {\n    30\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write log: %v\", err)\n    31\t\t}\n    32\t\treturn path\n    33\t}\n    34\t\n    35\t// capture registers a writer under report that records what it was given and writes text.\n    36\ttype capture struct {\n    37\t\trecords []logread.Record\n    38\t\tskipped int\n    39\t\tcalls   int\n    40\t}\n    41\t\n    42\tfunc registerCapture(report string, text string) *capture {\n    43\t\tc := &capture{}\n    44\t\tcli.Register(report, func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n    45\t\t\tc.calls++\n    46\t\t\tc.records = records\n    47\t\t\tc.skipped = skipped\n    48\t\t\t_, err := io.WriteString(w, text)\n    49\t\t\treturn err\n    50\t\t})\n    51\t\treturn c\n    52\t}\n    53\t\n    54\tfunc recordIDs(records []logread.Record) []string {\n    55\t\tids := make([]string, 0, len(records))\n    56\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    57\t\t\tids = append(ids, rec.ExecutionID)\n    58\t\t}\n    59\t\treturn ids\n    60\t}\n    61\t\n    62\tfunc TestRunUsageErrorExit2(t *testing.T) {\n    63\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    64\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"frobnicate\", \"log.jsonl\"}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 2 {\n    65\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 2\", got)\n    66\t\t}\n    67\t}\n    68\t\n    69\tfunc TestRunUsageErrorWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n    70\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    71\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\"}, &stdout, &stderr)\n    72\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n    73\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n    74\t\t}\n    75\t\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n    76\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n    77\t\t}\n    78\t}\n    79\t\n    80\tfunc TestRunMissingLogExit1(t *testing.T) {\n    81\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    82\t\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n    83\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 1 {\n    84\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 1\", got)\n    85\t\t}\n    86\t}\n    87\t\n    88\tfunc TestRunMissingLogWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n    89\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    90\t\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n    91\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr)\n    92\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n    93\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n    94\t\t}\n    95\t\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n    96\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n    97\t\t}\n    98\t}\n    99\t\n   100\tfunc TestRunSkippedLinesStillExit0(t *testing.T) {\n   101\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"), \"{not json\", logLine(\"b\", \"2026-10-15\", \"Toml\"))\n   102\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"ok\\n\")\n   103\t\n   104\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   105\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   106\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   107\t\t}\n   108\t\tif c.skipped != 1 {\n   109\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want 1\", c.skipped)\n   110\t\t}\n   111\t\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(recordIDs(c.records), want) {\n   112\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want %v\", recordIDs(c.records), want)\n   113\t\t}\n   114\t}\n   115\t\n   116\tfunc TestRunFilterOrder(t *testing.T) {\n   117\t\tlog := writeLog(t,\n   118\t\t\tlogLine(\"early-toml\", \"2026-10-13\", \"Toml\"),\n   119\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"),\n   120\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-other\", \"2026-10-15\", \"CommonMark\"),\n   121\t\t\tlogLine(\"late-toml\", \"2026-10-17\", \"Toml\"),\n   122\t\t\t\"{malformed\",\n   123\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml-2\", \"2026-10-16\", \"Toml\"),\n   124\t\t)\n   125\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"\")\n   126\t\n   127\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   128\t\tgot := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"Toml\", \"--since\", \"2026-10-14\", \"--until\", \"2026-10-16\", log}, &stdout, &stderr)\n   129\t\tif got != 0 {\n   130\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   131\t\t}\n   132\t\tif want := []string{\"in-toml\", \"in-toml-2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(recordIDs(c.records), want) {\n   133\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want %v\", recordIDs(c.records), want)\n   134\t\t}\n   135\t\tif c.skipped != 1 {\n   136\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want whole-file count 1\", c.skipped)\n   137\t\t}\n   138\t}\n   139\t\n   140\tfunc TestRunSkippedCountIgnoresFilters(t *testing.T) {\n   141\t\tlog := writeLog(t, \"{bad one\", logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"), \"{bad two\")\n   142\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"\")\n   143\t\n   144\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   145\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"NoSuchTarget\", log}, &stdout, &stderr)\n   146\t\tif len(c.records) != 0 {\n   147\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want none\", recordIDs(c.records))\n   148\t\t}\n   149\t\tif c.skipped != 2 {\n   150\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want 2\", c.skipped)\n   151\t\t}\n   152\t}\n   153\t\n   154\tfunc TestRunWriterOutputReachesStdoutOnSuccess(t *testing.T) {\n   155\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   156\t\tregisterCapture(\"summary\", \"report body\\n\")\n   157\t\n   158\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   159\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   160\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   161\t\t}\n   162\t\tif stdout.String() != \"report body\\n\" {\n   163\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want the writer's output\", stdout.String())\n   164\t\t}\n   165\t}\n   166\t\n   167\tfunc TestRunWriterErrorExit1WritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n   168\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   169\t\tcli.Register(\"targets\", func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n   170\t\t\tio.WriteString(w, \"partial output that must not escape\\n\")\n   171\t\t\treturn errors.New(\"boom\")\n   172\t\t})\n   173\t\n   174\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   175\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"targets\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 1 {\n   176\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 1\", got)\n   177\t\t}\n   178\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n   179\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n   180\t\t}\n   181\t}\n   182\t\n   183\tfunc TestRunUnregisteredReportExit0WritesNothing(t *testing.T) {\n   184\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   185\t\n   186\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   187\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"daily\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   188\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   189\t\t}\n   190\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n   191\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n   192\t\t}\n   193\t}\n=== internal/filter/filter.go\n     1\t// Package filter narrows a slice of logread.Record by Target and by start date.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// Every function here is pure: it performs no I/O, keeps no global state, and never modifies its\n     4\t// input slice. Input order is preserved.\n     5\tpackage filter\n     6\t\n     7\timport \"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n     8\t\n     9\t// ByTarget returns the records whose Target equals name exactly. Comparison is case-sensitive.\n    10\t// An empty name means no --target was given, so every record is returned. A name that matches no\n    11\t// record yields an empty slice, never an error.\n    12\tfunc ByTarget(records []logread.Record, name string) []logread.Record {\n    13\t\tout := make([]logread.Record, 0, len(records))\n    14\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    15\t\t\tif name == \"\" || rec.Target == name {\n    16\t\t\t\tout = append(out, rec)\n    17\t\t\t}\n    18\t\t}\n    19\t\treturn out\n    20\t}\n    21\t\n    22\t// ByDateRange returns the records whose Date lies within the inclusive range [since, until].\n    23\t// Dates are validated YYYY-MM-DD text, so string comparison orders them correctly. An empty bound\n    24\t// is unset and does not restrict. When since is later than until the result is empty; that is not\n    25\t// an error.\n    26\tfunc ByDateRange(records []logread.Record, since, until string) []logread.Record {\n    27\t\tout := make([]logread.Record, 0, len(records))\n    28\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    29\t\t\tif since != \"\" && rec.Date < since {\n    30\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    31\t\t\t}\n    32\t\t\tif until != \"\" && rec.Date > until {\n    33\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    34\t\t\t}\n    35\t\t\tout = append(out, rec)\n    36\t\t}\n    37\t\treturn out\n    38\t}\n=== internal/format/format.go\n     1\t// Package format holds the shared text formatters for minutes and cost columns.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// Every report that prints a minutes or cost column uses these functions, so the rounding rule\n     4\t// lives in exactly one place. Both functions are pure: they take no filters, read no input and\n     5\t// keep no state.\n     6\tpackage format\n     7\t\n     8\timport \"fmt\"\n     9\t\n    10\t// Minutes renders a duration in milliseconds as tenths of a minute with one decimal digit. The\n    11\t// duration is rounded to the nearest tenth using t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division, so\n    12\t// 95000 ms gives \"1.6\" and 0 ms gives \"0.0\".\n    13\tfunc Minutes(ms int64) string {\n    14\t\tt := (ms + 3000) / 6000\n    15\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%d.%d\", t/10, t%10)\n    16\t}\n    17\t\n    18\t// Cost renders a US-dollar amount with exactly four decimal places, so 0 gives \"0.0000\".\n    19\tfunc Cost(usd float64) string {\n    20\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%.4f\", usd)\n    21\t}\n=== internal/logread/logread.go\n     1\t// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n     4\t// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\n     5\tpackage logread\n     6\t\n     7\timport (\n     8\t\t\"bufio\"\n     9\t\t\"bytes\"\n    10\t\t\"encoding/json\"\n    11\t\t\"errors\"\n    12\t\t\"fmt\"\n    13\t\t\"io\"\n    14\t)\n    15\t\n    16\t// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\n    17\ttype Record struct {\n    18\t\tExecutionID    string\n    19\t\tStartedAt      string\n    20\t\tDate           string\n    21\t\tStatus         string\n    22\t\tFailed         bool\n    23\t\tCommand        string\n    24\t\tTarget         string\n    25\t\tProvider       string\n    26\t\tRequestedModel string\n    27\t\tModel          string\n    28\t\tInputTokens    int64\n    29\t\tCachedTokens   int64\n    30\t\tOutputTokens   int64\n    31\t\tCostUSD        float64\n    32\t\tElapsedMS      int64\n    33\t\tReturnCode     *int\n    34\t\tTimedOut       bool\n    35\t}\n    36\t\n    37\t// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\n    38\ttype Skip struct {\n    39\t\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n    40\t\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n    41\t}\n    42\t\n    43\t// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\n    44\ttype Result struct {\n    45\t\tRecords []Record\n    46\t\tSkipped int\n    47\t\tSkips   []Skip\n    48\t}\n    49\t\n    50\t// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. The required string fields are typed so that a wrong\n    51\t// type skips the line. Every other field is kept raw and decoded leniently by parseLine, so a\n    52\t// value of the wrong JSON type never costs the whole line.\n    53\ttype wireLine struct {\n    54\t\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n    55\t\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n    56\t\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n    57\t\tJob         struct {\n    58\t\t\tCommandName string          `json:\"command_name\"`\n    59\t\t\tTarget      string          `json:\"target\"`\n    60\t\t\tLLM         json.RawMessage `json:\"llm\"`\n    61\t\t\tModel       json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n    62\t\t} `json:\"job\"`\n    63\t\tResult json.RawMessage `json:\"result\"`\n    64\t}\n    65\t\n    66\t// wireResult mirrors the result object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\n    67\ttype wireResult struct {\n    68\t\tReturnCode json.RawMessage `json:\"returncode\"`\n    69\t\tTimedOut   json.RawMessage `json:\"timed_out\"`\n    70\t\tStats      json.RawMessage `json:\"stats\"`\n    71\t}\n    72\t\n    73\t// wireStats mirrors the result.stats object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\n    74\ttype wireStats struct {\n    75\t\tCachedInputTokens json.RawMessage `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n    76\t\tElapsedMS         json.RawMessage `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n    77\t\tInputTokens       json.RawMessage `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n    78\t\tOutputTokens      json.RawMessage `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n    79\t\tCostUSD           json.RawMessage `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n    80\t\tModel             json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n    81\t}\n    82\t\n    83\t// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n    84\t// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n    85\t// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n    86\t// only when reading from r fails.\n    87\tfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n    88\t\tif warn == nil {\n    89\t\t\twarn = io.Discard\n    90\t\t}\n    91\t\tvar res Result\n    92\t\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n    93\t\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n    94\t\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n    95\t\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n    96\t\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n    97\t\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n    98\t\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n    99\t\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n   100\t\t\t\t}\n   101\t\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n   102\t\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n   103\t\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n   104\t\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n   105\t\t\t\t} else {\n   106\t\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n   107\t\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n   108\t\t\t\t}\n   109\t\t\t}\n   110\t\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n   111\t\t\t\treturn res, nil\n   112\t\t\t}\n   113\t\t\tif err != nil {\n   114\t\t\t\treturn res, err\n   115\t\t\t}\n   116\t\t}\n   117\t}\n   118\t\n   119\t// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n   120\t// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string. Every other\n   121\t// field is optional: an absent, null or wrong-typed value takes its zero value, and a missing\n   122\t// result or stats object leaves the record with zero numbers.\n   123\t//\n   124\t// Model is result.stats.model when that is a non-empty string, otherwise job.model.\n   125\tfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n   126\t\tif data[0] != '{' {\n   127\t\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n   128\t\t}\n   129\t\tvar w wireLine\n   130\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n   131\t\t\treturn Record{}, err\n   132\t\t}\n   133\t\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n   134\t\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n   135\t\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n   136\t\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n   137\t\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n   138\t\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n   139\t\t}\n   140\t\tfor _, field := range required {\n   141\t\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n   142\t\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n   143\t\t\t}\n   144\t\t}\n   145\t\tvar res wireResult\n   146\t\tdecodeObject(w.Result, &res)\n   147\t\tvar stats wireStats\n   148\t\tdecodeObject(res.Stats, &stats)\n   149\t\n   150\t\trequested := stringValue(w.Job.Model)\n   151\t\tmodel := stringValue(stats.Model)\n   152\t\tif model == \"\" {\n   153\t\t\tmodel = requested\n   154\t\t}\n   155\t\treturn Record{\n   156\t\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n   157\t\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n   158\t\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n   159\t\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n   160\t\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n   161\t\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n   162\t\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n   163\t\t\tProvider:       stringValue(w.Job.LLM),\n   164\t\t\tRequestedModel: requested,\n   165\t\t\tModel:          model,\n   166\t\t\tInputTokens:    intValue(stats.InputTokens),\n   167\t\t\tCachedTokens:   intValue(stats.CachedInputTokens),\n   168\t\t\tOutputTokens:   intValue(stats.OutputTokens),\n   169\t\t\tCostUSD:        floatValue(stats.CostUSD),\n   170\t\t\tElapsedMS:      intValue(stats.ElapsedMS),\n   171\t\t\tReturnCode:     returnCode(res.ReturnCode),\n   172\t\t\tTimedOut:       boolValue(res.TimedOut),\n   173\t\t}, nil\n   174\t}\n   175\t\n   176\t// decodeObject decodes raw into v when raw holds a JSON object. Absent, null and non-object values\n   177\t// leave v at its zero value.\n   178\tfunc decodeObject(raw json.RawMessage, v any) {\n   179\t\tif len(raw) > 0 {\n   180\t\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, v)\n   181\t\t}\n   182\t}\n   183\t\n   184\t// intValue returns raw as an int64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\n   185\tfunc intValue(raw json.RawMessage) int64 {\n   186\t\tvar n int64\n   187\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &n)\n   188\t\treturn n\n   189\t}\n   190\t\n   191\t// floatValue returns raw as a float64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not a number.\n   192\tfunc floatValue(raw json.RawMessage) float64 {\n   193\t\tvar f float64\n   194\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &f)\n   195\t\treturn f\n   196\t}\n   197\t\n   198\t// stringValue returns raw as a string, or the empty string when raw is absent, null or not a string.\n   199\tfunc stringValue(raw json.RawMessage) string {\n   200\t\tvar s string\n   201\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &s)\n   202\t\treturn s\n   203\t}\n   204\t\n   205\t// boolValue returns raw as a bool, or false when raw is absent, null or not a bool.\n   206\tfunc boolValue(raw json.RawMessage) bool {\n   207\t\tvar b bool\n   208\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &b)\n   209\t\treturn b\n   210\t}\n   211\t\n   212\t// returnCode returns raw as a return code. It is nil when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\n   213\tfunc returnCode(raw json.RawMessage) *int {\n   214\t\tvar n int\n   215\t\tif json.Unmarshal(raw, &n) != nil || string(raw) == \"null\" {\n   216\t\t\treturn nil\n   217\t\t}\n   218\t\treturn &n\n   219\t}\n   220\t\n   221\t// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\n   222\tfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n   223\t\tr := []rune(s)\n   224\t\tif len(r) > n {\n   225\t\t\tr = r[:n]\n   226\t\t}\n   227\t\treturn string(r)\n   228\t}\n=== bin/test.sh\n     1\t#!/bin/sh\n     2\t# CommandCenter Operation\n     3\t# Name: Run Tests\n     4\t# Type: batch\n     5\t\n     6\t# Vet and test every package in the module. Exit status is the verdict.\n     7\tset -eu\n     8\tPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\n     9\tcd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n    10\t\n    11\tgo vet ./...\n    12\tgo test ./...\n=== go.mod\n     1\tmodule ddkstat\n     2\t\n     3\tgo 1.22","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74bce6e9-275c-490d-a098-b5de6b88b1e3","uuid":"847d62a6-99f2-4415-b9a3-eb1d053fa35e","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:51:26.005Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"=== cmd/ddkstat/main.go\n     1\t// Command ddkstat reports on Drydock's LLM execution log.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// The reporting pipeline lives in internal/cli. main only hands the arguments to cli.Run and exits\n     4\t// with its code; it is the only package in this module that may call os.Exit.\n     5\tpackage main\n     6\t\n     7\timport (\n     8\t\t\"os\"\n     9\t\n    10\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n    11\t)\n    12\t\n    13\tfunc main() {\n    14\t\tos.Exit(cli.Run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr))\n    15\t}\n=== cmd/ddkstat/layout_test.go\n     1\tpackage main\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"fmt\"\n     5\t\t\"os\"\n     6\t\t\"strings\"\n     7\t\t\"testing\"\n     8\t)\n     9\t\n    10\t// moduleRoot is the application root, two directories above this package.\n    11\tconst moduleRoot = \"../..\"\n    12\t\n    13\tfunc TestGoModDeclaresModuleAndGoVersion(t *testing.T) {\n    14\t\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.mod\")\n    15\t\tif err != nil {\n    16\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"read go.mod: %v\", err)\n    17\t\t}\n    18\t\tvar module, goVersion string\n    19\t\tvar requires int\n    20\t\tfor _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), \"\\n\") {\n    21\t\t\tfields := strings.Fields(line)\n    22\t\t\tif len(fields) == 0 {\n    23\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    24\t\t\t}\n    25\t\t\tswitch fields[0] {\n    26\t\t\tcase \"module\":\n    27\t\t\t\tmodule = fields[1]\n    28\t\t\tcase \"go\":\n    29\t\t\t\tgoVersion = fields[1]\n    30\t\t\tcase \"require\":\n    31\t\t\t\trequires++\n    32\t\t\t}\n    33\t\t}\n    34\t\tif module != \"ddkstat\" {\n    35\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"module = %q, want %q\", module, \"ddkstat\")\n    36\t\t}\n    37\t\tvar major, minor int\n    38\t\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(goVersion, \"%d.%d\", &major, &minor); err != nil {\n    39\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"go directive %q is not major.minor: %v\", goVersion, err)\n    40\t\t}\n    41\t\tif major < 1 || (major == 1 && minor < 22) {\n    42\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"go directive = %q, want 1.22 or newer\", goVersion)\n    43\t\t}\n    44\t\tif requires != 0 {\n    45\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"found %d require directives, want none\", requires)\n    46\t\t}\n    47\t}\n    48\t\n    49\tfunc TestLayoutDirectoriesExist(t *testing.T) {\n    50\t\tfor _, dir := range []string{\"cmd/ddkstat\", \"internal\", \"bin\"} {\n    51\t\t\tinfo, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/\" + dir)\n    52\t\t\tif err != nil {\n    53\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stat %s: %v\", dir, err)\n    54\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    55\t\t\t}\n    56\t\t\tif !info.IsDir() {\n    57\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n    58\t\t\t}\n    59\t\t}\n    60\t}\n    61\t\n    62\tfunc TestNoVendorOrDependencySums(t *testing.T) {\n    63\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/vendor\"); err == nil {\n    64\t\t\tt.Error(\"vendor directory exists, want none\")\n    65\t\t}\n    66\t\tsum, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.sum\")\n    67\t\tif err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(sum)) != \"\" {\n    68\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"go.sum is not empty: %q\", sum)\n    69\t\t}\n    70\t}\n=== internal/cli/args.go\n     1\t// Package cli parses and validates ddkstat invocations.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// ParseArgs performs no I/O and never exits the process.\n     4\tpackage cli\n     5\t\n     6\timport (\n     7\t\t\"fmt\"\n     8\t\t\"strings\"\n     9\t\t\"time\"\n    10\t)\n    11\t\n    12\t// Options is a validated ddkstat invocation.\n    13\ttype Options struct {\n    14\t\tReport  string\n    15\t\tTarget  string\n    16\t\tSince   string\n    17\t\tUntil   string\n    18\t\tLogPath string\n    19\t}\n    20\t\n    21\t// UsageError reports an invocation that does not match the ddkstat command line.\n    22\ttype UsageError struct {\n    23\t\tMsg string\n    24\t}\n    25\t\n    26\tfunc (e *UsageError) Error() string { return e.Msg }\n    27\t\n    28\tfunc usageErrorf(format string, args ...any) error {\n    29\t\treturn &UsageError{Msg: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)}\n    30\t}\n    31\t\n    32\tvar knownReports = map[string]bool{\n    33\t\t\"summary\":  true,\n    34\t\t\"commands\": true,\n    35\t\t\"targets\":  true,\n    36\t\t\"models\":   true,\n    37\t\t\"daily\":    true,\n    38\t\t\"failures\": true,\n    39\t}\n    40\t\n    41\t// checkDate requires value to be a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD. Parsing alone is not\n    42\t// enough: time.Parse accepts shapes such as 2026-1-5, so the value must also round-trip exactly.\n    43\tfunc checkDate(name, value string) error {\n    44\t\tparsed, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value)\n    45\t\tif err != nil || parsed.Format(dateLayout) != value {\n    46\t\t\treturn usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, got %q\", name, value)\n    47\t\t}\n    48\t\treturn nil\n    49\t}\n    50\t\n    51\tconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n    52\t\n    53\t// ParseArgs parses the arguments that follow the program name into Options. The order is fixed:\n    54\t// the report name, then any --target, --since or --until options, then exactly one log path.\n    55\t// Every failure is a *UsageError.\n    56\tfunc ParseArgs(args []string) (Options, error) {\n    57\t\tif len(args) == 0 {\n    58\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"missing report name\")\n    59\t\t}\n    60\t\tif !knownReports[args[0]] {\n    61\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown report %q\", args[0])\n    62\t\t}\n    63\t\topts := Options{Report: args[0]}\n    64\t\n    65\t\ti := 1\n    66\t\tfor ; i < len(args) && strings.HasPrefix(args[i], \"--\"); i += 2 {\n    67\t\t\tname := args[i]\n    68\t\t\tswitch name {\n    69\t\t\tcase \"--target\", \"--since\", \"--until\":\n    70\t\t\tdefault:\n    71\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown option %q\", name)\n    72\t\t\t}\n    73\t\t\tif i+1 >= len(args) {\n    74\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a value\", name)\n    75\t\t\t}\n    76\t\t\tvalue := args[i+1]\n    77\t\t\tswitch name {\n    78\t\t\tcase \"--target\":\n    79\t\t\t\topts.Target = value\n    80\t\t\tcase \"--since\":\n    81\t\t\t\tif err := checkDate(name, value); err != nil {\n    82\t\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, err\n    83\t\t\t\t}\n    84\t\t\t\topts.Since = value\n    85\t\t\tcase \"--until\":\n    86\t\t\t\tif err := checkDate(name, value); err != nil {\n    87\t\t\t\t\treturn Options{}, err\n    88\t\t\t\t}\n    89\t\t\t\topts.Until = value\n    90\t\t\t}\n    91\t\t}\n    92\t\n    93\t\tpositional := args[i:]\n    94\t\tswitch len(positional) {\n    95\t\tcase 0:\n    96\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"missing log path\")\n    97\t\tcase 1:\n    98\t\t\topts.LogPath = positional[0]\n    99\t\t\treturn opts, nil\n   100\t\tdefault:\n   101\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unexpected argument %q\", positional[1])\n   102\t\t}\n   103\t}\n=== internal/cli/run.go\n     1\tpackage cli\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"bytes\"\n     5\t\t\"fmt\"\n     6\t\t\"io\"\n     7\t\t\"os\"\n     8\t\n     9\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/filter\"\n    10\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n    11\t)\n    12\t\n    13\t// ReportWriter writes one report for records already narrowed by the filters. skipped is the\n    14\t// whole-file count of lines that logread did not keep.\n    15\ttype ReportWriter func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error\n    16\t\n    17\t// writers maps a report name to the writer that a report story registered for it.\n    18\tvar writers = map[string]ReportWriter{}\n    19\t\n    20\t// Register makes fn the writer for the report called name. Each report story calls it once from\n    21\t// its own package, so Run never imports a report package.\n    22\tfunc Register(name string, fn ReportWriter) {\n    23\t\twriters[name] = fn\n    24\t}\n    25\t\n    26\t// Run executes one ddkstat invocation. args are the arguments that follow the program name. It\n    27\t// returns the process exit code: 0 on success, 1 when the log cannot be read or a report writer\n    28\t// fails, and 2 on a usage error. Run never calls os.Exit; only cmd/ddkstat does.\n    29\t//\n    30\t// Report output is buffered and written to stdout only when the writer succeeds. Diagnostics go to\n    31\t// stderr, and skipped log lines never change the exit code.\n    32\tfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n    33\t\topts, err := ParseArgs(args)\n    34\t\tif err != nil {\n    35\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"usage: ddkstat {summary|commands|targets|models|daily|failures} [--target NAME] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] LOG\\n\")\n    36\t\t\treturn 2\n    37\t\t}\n    38\t\n    39\t\tf, err := os.Open(opts.LogPath)\n    40\t\tif err != nil {\n    41\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot open log %s: %v\\n\", opts.LogPath, err)\n    42\t\t\treturn 1\n    43\t\t}\n    44\t\tdefer f.Close()\n    45\t\n    46\t\tres, err := logread.Read(f, stderr)\n    47\t\tif err != nil {\n    48\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot read log %s: %v\\n\", opts.LogPath, err)\n    49\t\t\treturn 1\n    50\t\t}\n    51\t\n    52\t\trecords := filter.ByDateRange(filter.ByTarget(res.Records, opts.Target), opts.Since, opts.Until)\n    53\t\n    54\t\twrite, ok := writers[opts.Report]\n    55\t\tif !ok {\n    56\t\t\treturn 0\n    57\t\t}\n    58\t\n    59\t\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n    60\t\tif err := write(&buf, records, res.Skipped); err != nil {\n    61\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot write %s report: %v\\n\", opts.Report, err)\n    62\t\t\treturn 1\n    63\t\t}\n    64\t\tif _, err := buf.WriteTo(stdout); err != nil {\n    65\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot write report to stdout: %v\\n\", err)\n    66\t\t\treturn 1\n    67\t\t}\n    68\t\treturn 0\n    69\t}\n=== internal/cli/run_test.go\n     1\tpackage cli_test\n     2\t\n     3\timport (\n     4\t\t\"bytes\"\n     5\t\t\"errors\"\n     6\t\t\"io\"\n     7\t\t\"os\"\n     8\t\t\"path/filepath\"\n     9\t\t\"reflect\"\n    10\t\t\"strings\"\n    11\t\t\"testing\"\n    12\t\n    13\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n    14\t\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n    15\t)\n    16\t\n    17\t// logLine returns one valid JSON Lines record with the given identifier, start date and target.\n    18\tfunc logLine(id, date, target string) string {\n    19\t\treturn `{\"execution_id\":\"` + id + `\",\"started_at\":\"` + date + `T02:38:41.904Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n    20\t\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"` + target + `\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"},` +\n    21\t\t\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":1,\"cached_input_tokens\":2,` +\n    22\t\t\t`\"output_tokens\":3,\"cost_usd\":0.5,\"elapsed_ms\":4}}}`\n    23\t}\n    24\t\n    25\t// writeLog writes lines to a fresh file under t.TempDir and returns its path.\n    26\tfunc writeLog(t *testing.T, lines ...string) string {\n    27\t\tt.Helper()\n    28\t\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"log.jsonl\")\n    29\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.Join(lines, \"\\n\")+\"\\n\"), 0o644); err != nil {\n    30\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write log: %v\", err)\n    31\t\t}\n    32\t\treturn path\n    33\t}\n    34\t\n    35\t// capture registers a writer under report that records what it was given and writes text.\n    36\ttype capture struct {\n    37\t\trecords []logread.Record\n    38\t\tskipped int\n    39\t\tcalls   int\n    40\t}\n    41\t\n    42\tfunc registerCapture(report string, text string) *capture {\n    43\t\tc := &capture{}\n    44\t\tcli.Register(report, func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n    45\t\t\tc.calls++\n    46\t\t\tc.records = records\n    47\t\t\tc.skipped = skipped\n    48\t\t\t_, err := io.WriteString(w, text)\n    49\t\t\treturn err\n    50\t\t})\n    51\t\treturn c\n    52\t}\n    53\t\n    54\tfunc recordIDs(records []logread.Record) []string {\n    55\t\tids := make([]string, 0, len(records))\n    56\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    57\t\t\tids = append(ids, rec.ExecutionID)\n    58\t\t}\n    59\t\treturn ids\n    60\t}\n    61\t\n    62\tfunc TestRunUsageErrorExit2(t *testing.T) {\n    63\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    64\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"frobnicate\", \"log.jsonl\"}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 2 {\n    65\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 2\", got)\n    66\t\t}\n    67\t}\n    68\t\n    69\tfunc TestRunUsageErrorWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n    70\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    71\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\"}, &stdout, &stderr)\n    72\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n    73\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n    74\t\t}\n    75\t\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n    76\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n    77\t\t}\n    78\t}\n    79\t\n    80\tfunc TestRunMissingLogExit1(t *testing.T) {\n    81\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    82\t\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n    83\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 1 {\n    84\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 1\", got)\n    85\t\t}\n    86\t}\n    87\t\n    88\tfunc TestRunMissingLogWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n    89\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n    90\t\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n    91\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr)\n    92\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n    93\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n    94\t\t}\n    95\t\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n    96\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n    97\t\t}\n    98\t}\n    99\t\n   100\tfunc TestRunSkippedLinesStillExit0(t *testing.T) {\n   101\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"), \"{not json\", logLine(\"b\", \"2026-10-15\", \"Toml\"))\n   102\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"ok\\n\")\n   103\t\n   104\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   105\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   106\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   107\t\t}\n   108\t\tif c.skipped != 1 {\n   109\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want 1\", c.skipped)\n   110\t\t}\n   111\t\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(recordIDs(c.records), want) {\n   112\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want %v\", recordIDs(c.records), want)\n   113\t\t}\n   114\t}\n   115\t\n   116\tfunc TestRunFilterOrder(t *testing.T) {\n   117\t\tlog := writeLog(t,\n   118\t\t\tlogLine(\"early-toml\", \"2026-10-13\", \"Toml\"),\n   119\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"),\n   120\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-other\", \"2026-10-15\", \"CommonMark\"),\n   121\t\t\tlogLine(\"late-toml\", \"2026-10-17\", \"Toml\"),\n   122\t\t\t\"{malformed\",\n   123\t\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml-2\", \"2026-10-16\", \"Toml\"),\n   124\t\t)\n   125\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"\")\n   126\t\n   127\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   128\t\tgot := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"Toml\", \"--since\", \"2026-10-14\", \"--until\", \"2026-10-16\", log}, &stdout, &stderr)\n   129\t\tif got != 0 {\n   130\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   131\t\t}\n   132\t\tif want := []string{\"in-toml\", \"in-toml-2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(recordIDs(c.records), want) {\n   133\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want %v\", recordIDs(c.records), want)\n   134\t\t}\n   135\t\tif c.skipped != 1 {\n   136\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want whole-file count 1\", c.skipped)\n   137\t\t}\n   138\t}\n   139\t\n   140\tfunc TestRunSkippedCountIgnoresFilters(t *testing.T) {\n   141\t\tlog := writeLog(t, \"{bad one\", logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"), \"{bad two\")\n   142\t\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"\")\n   143\t\n   144\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   145\t\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"NoSuchTarget\", log}, &stdout, &stderr)\n   146\t\tif len(c.records) != 0 {\n   147\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want none\", recordIDs(c.records))\n   148\t\t}\n   149\t\tif c.skipped != 2 {\n   150\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want 2\", c.skipped)\n   151\t\t}\n   152\t}\n   153\t\n   154\tfunc TestRunWriterOutputReachesStdoutOnSuccess(t *testing.T) {\n   155\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   156\t\tregisterCapture(\"summary\", \"report body\\n\")\n   157\t\n   158\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   159\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   160\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   161\t\t}\n   162\t\tif stdout.String() != \"report body\\n\" {\n   163\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want the writer's output\", stdout.String())\n   164\t\t}\n   165\t}\n   166\t\n   167\tfunc TestRunWriterErrorExit1WritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n   168\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   169\t\tcli.Register(\"targets\", func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n   170\t\t\tio.WriteString(w, \"partial output that must not escape\\n\")\n   171\t\t\treturn errors.New(\"boom\")\n   172\t\t})\n   173\t\n   174\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   175\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"targets\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 1 {\n   176\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 1\", got)\n   177\t\t}\n   178\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n   179\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n   180\t\t}\n   181\t}\n   182\t\n   183\tfunc TestRunUnregisteredReportExit0WritesNothing(t *testing.T) {\n   184\t\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"))\n   185\t\n   186\t\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n   187\t\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"daily\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n   188\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n   189\t\t}\n   190\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n   191\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n   192\t\t}\n   193\t}\n=== internal/filter/filter.go\n     1\t// Package filter narrows a slice of logread.Record by Target and by start date.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// Every function here is pure: it performs no I/O, keeps no global state, and never modifies its\n     4\t// input slice. Input order is preserved.\n     5\tpackage filter\n     6\t\n     7\timport \"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n     8\t\n     9\t// ByTarget returns the records whose Target equals name exactly. Comparison is case-sensitive.\n    10\t// An empty name means no --target was given, so every record is returned. A name that matches no\n    11\t// record yields an empty slice, never an error.\n    12\tfunc ByTarget(records []logread.Record, name string) []logread.Record {\n    13\t\tout := make([]logread.Record, 0, len(records))\n    14\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    15\t\t\tif name == \"\" || rec.Target == name {\n    16\t\t\t\tout = append(out, rec)\n    17\t\t\t}\n    18\t\t}\n    19\t\treturn out\n    20\t}\n    21\t\n    22\t// ByDateRange returns the records whose Date lies within the inclusive range [since, until].\n    23\t// Dates are validated YYYY-MM-DD text, so string comparison orders them correctly. An empty bound\n    24\t// is unset and does not restrict. When since is later than until the result is empty; that is not\n    25\t// an error.\n    26\tfunc ByDateRange(records []logread.Record, since, until string) []logread.Record {\n    27\t\tout := make([]logread.Record, 0, len(records))\n    28\t\tfor _, rec := range records {\n    29\t\t\tif since != \"\" && rec.Date < since {\n    30\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    31\t\t\t}\n    32\t\t\tif until != \"\" && rec.Date > until {\n    33\t\t\t\tcontinue\n    34\t\t\t}\n    35\t\t\tout = append(out, rec)\n    36\t\t}\n    37\t\treturn out\n    38\t}\n=== internal/format/format.go\n     1\t// Package format holds the shared text formatters for minutes and cost columns.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// Every report that prints a minutes or cost column uses these functions, so the rounding rule\n     4\t// lives in exactly one place. Both functions are pure: they take no filters, read no input and\n     5\t// keep no state.\n     6\tpackage format\n     7\t\n     8\timport \"fmt\"\n     9\t\n    10\t// Minutes renders a duration in milliseconds as tenths of a minute with one decimal digit. The\n    11\t// duration is rounded to the nearest tenth using t = (ms + 3000) / 6000 in integer division, so\n    12\t// 95000 ms gives \"1.6\" and 0 ms gives \"0.0\".\n    13\tfunc Minutes(ms int64) string {\n    14\t\tt := (ms + 3000) / 6000\n    15\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%d.%d\", t/10, t%10)\n    16\t}\n    17\t\n    18\t// Cost renders a US-dollar amount with exactly four decimal places, so 0 gives \"0.0000\".\n    19\tfunc Cost(usd float64) string {\n    20\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%.4f\", usd)\n    21\t}\n=== internal/logread/logread.go\n     1\t// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n     2\t//\n     3\t// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n     4\t// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\n     5\tpackage logread\n     6\t\n     7\timport (\n     8\t\t\"bufio\"\n     9\t\t\"bytes\"\n    10\t\t\"encoding/json\"\n    11\t\t\"errors\"\n    12\t\t\"fmt\"\n    13\t\t\"io\"\n    14\t)\n    15\t\n    16\t// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\n    17\ttype Record struct {\n    18\t\tExecutionID    string\n    19\t\tStartedAt      string\n    20\t\tDate           string\n    21\t\tStatus         string\n    22\t\tFailed         bool\n    23\t\tCommand        string\n    24\t\tTarget         string\n    25\t\tProvider       string\n    26\t\tRequestedModel string\n    27\t\tModel          string\n    28\t\tInputTokens    int64\n    29\t\tCachedTokens   int64\n    30\t\tOutputTokens   int64\n    31\t\tCostUSD        float64\n    32\t\tElapsedMS      int64\n    33\t\tReturnCode     *int\n    34\t\tTimedOut       bool\n    35\t}\n    36\t\n    37\t// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\n    38\ttype Skip struct {\n    39\t\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n    40\t\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n    41\t}\n    42\t\n    43\t// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\n    44\ttype Result struct {\n    45\t\tRecords []Record\n    46\t\tSkipped int\n    47\t\tSkips   []Skip\n    48\t}\n    49\t\n    50\t// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. The required string fields are typed so that a wrong\n    51\t// type skips the line. Every other field is kept raw and decoded leniently by parseLine, so a\n    52\t// value of the wrong JSON type never costs the whole line.\n    53\ttype wireLine struct {\n    54\t\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n    55\t\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n    56\t\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n    57\t\tJob         struct {\n    58\t\t\tCommandName string          `json:\"command_name\"`\n    59\t\t\tTarget      string          `json:\"target\"`\n    60\t\t\tLLM         json.RawMessage `json:\"llm\"`\n    61\t\t\tModel       json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n    62\t\t} `json:\"job\"`\n    63\t\tResult json.RawMessage `json:\"result\"`\n    64\t}\n    65\t\n    66\t// wireResult mirrors the result object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\n    67\ttype wireResult struct {\n    68\t\tReturnCode json.RawMessage `json:\"returncode\"`\n    69\t\tTimedOut   json.RawMessage `json:\"timed_out\"`\n    70\t\tStats      json.RawMessage `json:\"stats\"`\n    71\t}\n    72\t\n    73\t// wireStats mirrors the result.stats object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\n    74\ttype wireStats struct {\n    75\t\tCachedInputTokens json.RawMessage `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n    76\t\tElapsedMS         json.RawMessage `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n    77\t\tInputTokens       json.RawMessage `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n    78\t\tOutputTokens      json.RawMessage `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n    79\t\tCostUSD           json.RawMessage `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n    80\t\tModel             json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n    81\t}\n    82\t\n    83\t// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n    84\t// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n    85\t// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n    86\t// only when reading from r fails.\n    87\tfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n    88\t\tif warn == nil {\n    89\t\t\twarn = io.Discard\n    90\t\t}\n    91\t\tvar res Result\n    92\t\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n    93\t\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n    94\t\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n    95\t\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n    96\t\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n    97\t\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n    98\t\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n    99\t\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n   100\t\t\t\t}\n   101\t\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n   102\t\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n   103\t\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n   104\t\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n   105\t\t\t\t} else {\n   106\t\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n   107\t\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n   108\t\t\t\t}\n   109\t\t\t}\n   110\t\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n   111\t\t\t\treturn res, nil\n   112\t\t\t}\n   113\t\t\tif err != nil {\n   114\t\t\t\treturn res, err\n   115\t\t\t}\n   116\t\t}\n   117\t}\n   118\t\n   119\t// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n   120\t// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string. Every other\n   121\t// field is optional: an absent, null or wrong-typed value takes its zero value, and a missing\n   122\t// result or stats object leaves the record with zero numbers.\n   123\t//\n   124\t// Model is result.stats.model when that is a non-empty string, otherwise job.model.\n   125\tfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n   126\t\tif data[0] != '{' {\n   127\t\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n   128\t\t}\n   129\t\tvar w wireLine\n   130\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n   131\t\t\treturn Record{}, err\n   132\t\t}\n   133\t\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n   134\t\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n   135\t\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n   136\t\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n   137\t\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n   138\t\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n   139\t\t}\n   140\t\tfor _, field := range required {\n   141\t\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n   142\t\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n   143\t\t\t}\n   144\t\t}\n   145\t\tvar res wireResult\n   146\t\tdecodeObject(w.Result, &res)\n   147\t\tvar stats wireStats\n   148\t\tdecodeObject(res.Stats, &stats)\n   149\t\n   150\t\trequested := stringValue(w.Job.Model)\n   151\t\tmodel := stringValue(stats.Model)\n   152\t\tif model == \"\" {\n   153\t\t\tmodel = requested\n   154\t\t}\n   155\t\treturn Record{\n   156\t\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n   157\t\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n   158\t\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n   159\t\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n   160\t\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n   161\t\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n   162\t\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n   163\t\t\tProvider:       stringValue(w.Job.LLM),\n   164\t\t\tRequestedModel: requested,\n   165\t\t\tModel:          model,\n   166\t\t\tInputTokens:    intValue(stats.InputTokens),\n   167\t\t\tCachedTokens:   intValue(stats.CachedInputTokens),\n   168\t\t\tOutputTokens:   intValue(stats.OutputTokens),\n   169\t\t\tCostUSD:        floatValue(stats.CostUSD),\n   170\t\t\tElapsedMS:      intValue(stats.ElapsedMS),\n   171\t\t\tReturnCode:     returnCode(res.ReturnCode),\n   172\t\t\tTimedOut:       boolValue(res.TimedOut),\n   173\t\t}, nil\n   174\t}\n   175\t\n   176\t// decodeObject decodes raw into v when raw holds a JSON object. Absent, null and non-object values\n   177\t// leave v at its zero value.\n   178\tfunc decodeObject(raw json.RawMessage, v any) {\n   179\t\tif len(raw) > 0 {\n   180\t\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, v)\n   181\t\t}\n   182\t}\n   183\t\n   184\t// intValue returns raw as an int64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\n   185\tfunc intValue(raw json.RawMessage) int64 {\n   186\t\tvar n int64\n   187\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &n)\n   188\t\treturn n\n   189\t}\n   190\t\n   191\t// floatValue returns raw as a float64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not a number.\n   192\tfunc floatValue(raw json.RawMessage) float64 {\n   193\t\tvar f float64\n   194\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &f)\n   195\t\treturn f\n   196\t}\n   197\t\n   198\t// stringValue returns raw as a string, or the empty string when raw is absent, null or not a string.\n   199\tfunc stringValue(raw json.RawMessage) string {\n   200\t\tvar s string\n   201\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &s)\n   202\t\treturn s\n   203\t}\n   204\t\n   205\t// boolValue returns raw as a bool, or false when raw is absent, null or not a bool.\n   206\tfunc boolValue(raw json.RawMessage) bool {\n   207\t\tvar b bool\n   208\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &b)\n   209\t\treturn b\n   210\t}\n   211\t\n   212\t// returnCode returns raw as a return code. It is nil when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\n   213\tfunc returnCode(raw json.RawMessage) *int {\n   214\t\tvar n int\n   215\t\tif json.Unmarshal(raw, &n) != nil || string(raw) == \"null\" {\n   216\t\t\treturn nil\n   217\t\t}\n   218\t\treturn &n\n   219\t}\n   220\t\n   221\t// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\n   222\tfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n   223\t\tr := []rune(s)\n   224\t\tif len(r) > n {\n   225\t\t\tr = r[:n]\n   226\t\t}\n   227\t\treturn string(r)\n   228\t}\n=== bin/test.sh\n     1\t#!/bin/sh\n     2\t# CommandCenter Operation\n     3\t# Name: Run Tests\n     4\t# Type: batch\n     5\t\n     6\t# Vet and test every package in the module. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgR7mDG47CeHu7Dkatn3q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013J7YaQjHDTvbor3KfyG2fs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/report.go","content":"// Package report builds the six ddkstat CSV reports from records already narrowed by the filters.\n//\n// Each report has an aggregate or selection function, which is pure, and a writer, which formats\n// its result as CSV with \\n line endings. Text values are written unquoted and unescaped.\n//\n// The writers are registered with cli.Register from init, so cli.Run reaches them without importing\n// this package. cmd/ddkstat imports this package for that side effect.\npackage report\n\nimport (\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n)\n\nfunc init() { Register() }\n\n// Register makes the writer of every report available to cli.Run. Registering again replaces the\n// writers with the same ones, so it is safe to call more than once.\nfunc Register() {\n\tcli.Register(\"summary\", WriteSummary)\n\tcli.Register(\"commands\", WriteCommands)\n\tcli.Register(\"targets\", WriteTargets)\n\tcli.Register(\"models\", WriteModels)\n\tcli.Register(\"daily\", WriteDaily)\n\tcli.Register(\"failures\", WriteFailures)\n}\n\n// Totals is the sum over a group of records, or over every filtered record for a TOTAL row.\ntype Totals struct {\n\tCalls        int64\n\tFailed       int64\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n}\n\n// Add folds one record into the totals.\nfunc (t *Totals) Add(rec recordFields) {\n\tt.Calls++\n\tif rec.Failed {\n\t\tt.Failed++\n\t}\n\tt.InputTokens += rec.InputTokens\n\tt.CachedTokens += rec.CachedTokens\n\tt.OutputTokens += rec.OutputTokens\n\tt.CostUSD += rec.CostUSD\n\tt.ElapsedMS += rec.ElapsedMS\n}\n\n// Tokens is input plus cached plus output tokens.\nfunc (t Totals) Tokens() int64 {\n\treturn t.InputTokens + t.CachedTokens + t.OutputTokens\n}\n\n// writeTable writes each row as one comma-separated line ended by \\n.\nfunc writeTable(w io.Writer, rows [][]string) error {\n\tfor _, row := range rows {\n\t\tif _, err := io.WriteString(w, strings.Join(row, \",\")+\"\\n\"); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// itoa renders an integer count or token total in decimal.\nfunc itoa(n int64) string {\n\treturn strconv.FormatInt(n, 10)\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":19437,"cache_read_input_tokens":46823,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":19437},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74bce6e9-275c-490d-a098-b5de6b88b1e3","uuid":"de5288d2-53fc-4a6a-97a8-341cf7633ddb","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:52:56.180Z","request_id":"req_011CgR7mCuiTLLarMMkuKJni","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_013J7YaQjHDTvbor3KfyG2fs":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/report.go","content":"// Package report builds the six ddkstat CSV reports from records already narrowed by the filters.\n//\n// Each report has an aggregate or selection function, which is pure, and a writer, which formats\n// its result as CSV with \\n line endings. Text values are written unquoted and unescaped.\n//\n// The writers are registered with cli.Register from init, so cli.Run reaches them without importing\n// this package. cmd/ddkstat imports this package for that side effect.\npackage report\n\nimport (\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n)\n\nfunc init() { Register() }\n\n// Register makes the writer of every report available to cli.Run. Registering again replaces the\n// writers with the same ones, so it is safe to call more than once.\nfunc Register() {\n\tcli.Register(\"summary\", WriteSummary)\n\tcli.Register(\"commands\", WriteCommands)\n\tcli.Register(\"targets\", WriteTargets)\n\tcli.Register(\"models\", WriteModels)\n\tcli.Register(\"daily\", WriteDaily)\n\tcli.Register(\"failures\", WriteFailures)\n}\n\n// Totals is the sum over a group of records, or over every filtered record for a TOTAL row.\ntype Totals struct {\n\tCalls        int64\n\tFailed       int64\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n}\n\n// Add folds one record into the totals.\nfunc (t *Totals) Add(rec recordFields) {\n\tt.Calls++\n\tif rec.Failed {\n\t\tt.Failed++\n\t}\n\tt.InputTokens += rec.InputTokens\n\tt.CachedTokens += rec.CachedTokens\n\tt.OutputTokens += rec.OutputTokens\n\tt.CostUSD += rec.CostUSD\n\tt.ElapsedMS += rec.ElapsedMS\n}\n\n// Tokens is input plus cached plus output tokens.\nfunc (t Totals) Tokens() int64 {\n\treturn t.InputTokens + t.CachedTokens + t.OutputTokens\n}\n\n// writeTable writes each row as one comma-separated line ended by \\n.\nfunc writeTable(w io.Writer, rows [][]string) error {\n\tfor _, row := range rows {\n\t\tif _, err := io.WriteString(w, strings.Join(row, \",\")+\"\\n\"); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// itoa renders an integer count or token total in decimal.\nfunc itoa(n int64) string {\n\treturn strconv.FormatInt(n, 10)\n}\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RUfVXSFEPoirhnJzv6nXgn","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/report.go has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74bce6e9-275c-490d-a098-b5de6b88b1e3","uuid":"e9412098-687c-46ab-8bc9-4ac153a79392","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:52:58.987Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/report.go","oldString":"func (t *Totals) Add(rec recordFields) {","newString":"func (t *Totals) Add(rec logread.Record) {","originalFile":"// Package report builds the six ddkstat CSV reports from records already narrowed by the filters.\n//\n// Each report has an aggregate or selection function, which is pure, and a writer, which formats\n// its result as CSV with \\n line endings. Text values are written unquoted and unescaped.\n//\n// The writers are registered with cli.Register from init, so cli.Run reaches them without importing\n// this package. cmd/ddkstat imports this package for that side effect.\npackage report\n\nimport (\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n)\n\nfunc init() { Register() }\n\n// Register makes the writer of every report available to cli.Run. Registering again replaces the\n// writers with the same ones, so it is safe to call more than once.\nfunc Register() {\n\tcli.Register(\"summary\", WriteSummary)\n\tcli.Register(\"commands\", WriteCommands)\n\tcli.Register(\"targets\", WriteTargets)\n\tcli.Register(\"models\", WriteModels)\n\tcli.Register(\"daily\", WriteDaily)\n\tcli.Register(\"failures\", WriteFailures)\n}\n\n// Totals is the sum over a group of records, or over every filtered record for a TOTAL row.\ntype Totals struct {\n\tCalls        int64\n\tFailed       int64\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n}\n\n// Add folds one record into the totals.\nfunc (t *Totals) Add(rec recordFields) {\n\tt.Calls++\n\tif rec.Failed {\n\t\tt.Failed++\n\t}\n\tt.InputTokens += rec.InputTokens\n\tt.CachedTokens += rec.CachedTokens\n\tt.OutputTokens += rec.OutputTokens\n\tt.CostUSD += rec.CostUSD\n\tt.ElapsedMS += rec.ElapsedMS\n}\n\n// Tokens is input plus cached plus output tokens.\nfunc (t Totals) Tokens() int64 {\n\treturn t.InputTokens + t.CachedTokens + t.OutputTokens\n}\n\n// writeTable writes each row as one comma-separated line ended by \\n.\nfunc writeTable(w io.Writer, rows [][]string) error {\n\tfor _, row := range rows {\n\t\tif _, err := io.WriteString(w, strings.Join(row, \",\")+\"\\n\"); First and Last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when records\n// is empty.\nfunc SummaryAggregate(records []logread.Record, skipped int) Summary {\n\ts := Summary{Skipped: int64(skipped)}\n\tfor _, rec := range records {\n\t\ts.Add(rec)\n\t\tif s.Calls == 1 || rec.Date < s.First {\n\t\t\ts.First = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t\tif rec.Date > s.Last {\n\t\t\ts.Last = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// WriteSummary writes the summary report: a header and one data row.\nfunc WriteSummary(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n\ts := SummaryAggregate(records, skipped)\n\treturn writeTable(w, [][]string{\n\t\t{\"records\", \"skipped\", \"succeeded\", \"failed\", \"first\", \"last\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\titoa(s.Calls), itoa(s.Skipped), itoa(s.Calls - First and Last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when records\n// is empty.\nfunc SummaryAggregate(records []logread.Record, skipped int) Summary {\n\ts := Summary{Skipped: int64(skipped)}\n\tfor _, rec := range records {\n\t\ts.Add(rec)\n\t\tif s.Calls == 1 || rec.Date < s.First {\n\t\t\ts.First = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t\tif rec.Date > s.Last {\n\t\t\ts.Last = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// WriteSummary writes the summary report: a header and one data row.\nfunc WriteSummary(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n\ts := SummaryAggregate(records, skipped)\n\treturn writeTable(w, [][]string{\n\t\t{\"records\", \"skipped\", \"succeeded\", \"failed\", \"first\", \"last\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\titoa(s.Calls), itoa(s.Skipped), itoa(s.Calls - s.Failed), itoa(s.Failed), s.First, s.Last,\n\t\t\titoa(s.InputTokens), itoa(s.CachedTokens), itoa(s.OutputTokens),\n\t\t\tformat.Cost(s.CostUSD), format.Minutes(s.ElapsedMS),\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n"}}}

First and Last are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when records\n// is empty.\nfunc SummaryAggregate(records []logread.Record, skipped int) Summary {\n\ts := Summary{Skipped: int64(skipped)}\n\tfor _, rec := range records {\n\t\ts.Add(rec)\n\t\tif s.Calls == 1 || rec.Date < s.First {\n\t\t\ts.First = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t\tif rec.Date > s.Last {\n\t\t\ts.Last = rec.Date\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// WriteSummary writes the summary report: a header and one data row.\nfunc WriteSummary(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n\ts := SummaryAggregate(records, skipped)\n\treturn writeTable(w, [][]string{\n\t\t{\"records\", \"skipped\", \"succeeded\", \"failed\", \"first\", \"last\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\titoa(s.Calls), itoa(s.Skipped), itoa(s.Calls - s.Failed), itoa(s.Failed), s.First, s.Last,\n\t\t\titoa(s.InputTokens), itoa(s.CachedTokens), itoa(s.OutputTokens),\n\t\t\tformat.Cost(s.CostUSD), format.Minutes(s.ElapsedMS),\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01VFoX1QLqb1ZuaDBpaBdijL","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

It also returns the totals over every record, which become the TOTAL row.\nfunc AggregateCommands(records []logread.Record) ([]CommandTotals, Totals) {\n\tvar all Totals\n\tvar rows []CommandTotals\n\tindex := make(map[string]int)\n\tfor _, rec := range records {\n\t\tall.Add(rec)\n\t\ti, ok := index[rec.Command]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\ti = len(rows)\n\t\t\tindex[rec.Command] = i\n\t\t\trows = append(rows, CommandTotals{Command: rec.Command})\n\t\t}\n\t\trows[i].Add(rec)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(rows, func(a, b int) bool {\n\t\tif rows[a].Calls != rows[b].Calls {\n\t\t\treturn append(table, commandCells(\"TOTAL\", all)))\n}\n\n// commandCells renders one commands row with the given label in the command column.\nfunc commandCells(label string, t Totals) []string {\n\treturn []string{\n\t\tlabel, itoa(t.Calls), itoa(t.Failed), itoa(t.InputTokens), itoa(t.CachedTokens), got != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n\t}\n}\n","newString":"","originalFile":"package cli_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\n// logLine returns one valid JSON Lines record with the given identifier, start date and target.\nfunc logLine(id, date, target string) string {\n\treturn `{\"execution_id\":\"` + id + `\",\"started_at\":\"` + date + `T02:38:41.904Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"` + target + `\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"},` +\n\t\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":1,\"cached_input_tokens\":2,` +\n\t\t`\"output_tokens\":3,\"cost_usd\":0.5,\"elapsed_ms\":4}}}`\n}\n\n// writeLog writes lines to a fresh file under t.TempDir and returns its path.\nfunc writeLog(t *testing.T, lines ...string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"log.jsonl\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.Join(lines, \"\\n\")+\"\\n\"), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write log: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn path\n}\n\n// capture registers a writer under report that records what it was given and writes text.\ntype capture struct {\n\trecords []logread.Record\n\tskipped int\n\tcalls   int\n}\n\nfunc registerCapture(report string, text string) *capture {\n\tc := &capture{}\n\tcli.Register(report, func(w io.Writer, records []logread.Record, skipped int) error {\n\t\tc.calls++\n\t\tc.records = records\n\t\tc.skipped = skipped\n\t\t_, err := io.WriteString(w, text)\n\t\treturn err\n\t})\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc recordIDs(records []logread.Record) []string {\n\tids := make([]string, 0, len(records))\n\tfor _, rec := range records {\n\t\tids = append(ids, rec.ExecutionID)\n\t}\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc TestRunUsageErrorExit2(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"frobnicate\", \"log.jsonl\"}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 2 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 2\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunUsageErrorWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\"}, &stdout, &stderr)\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunMissingLogExit1(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run exit = %d, want 1\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunMissingLogWritesNothingToStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.jsonl\")\n\tcli.Run([]string{\"summary\", missing}, &stdout, &stderr)\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stdout = %q, want empty\", stdout.String())\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(stderr.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stderr has %d lines, want exactly 1\", n)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunSkippedLinesStillExit0(t *testing.T) {\n\tlog := writeLog(t, logLine(\"a\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"), \"{not json\", logLine(\"b\", \"2026-10-15\", \"Toml\"))\n\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"ok\\n\")\n\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif got := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); got != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n\t}\n\tif c.skipped != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer skipped = %d, want 1\", c.skipped)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(recordIDs(c.records), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"writer records = %v, want %v\", recordIDs(c.records), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunFilterOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\tlog := writeLog(t,\n\t\tlogLine(\"early-toml\", \"2026-10-13\", \"Toml\"),\n\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml\", \"2026-10-14\", \"Toml\"),\n\t\tlogLine(\"in-other\", \"2026-10-15\", \"CommonMark\"),\n\t\tlogLine(\"late-toml\", \"2026-10-17\", \"Toml\"),\n\t\t\"{malformed\",\n\t\tlogLine(\"in-toml-2\", \"2026-10-16\", \"Toml\"),\n\t)\n\tc := registerCapture(\"summary\", \"\")\n\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tgot := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"Toml\", \"--since\", \"2026-10-14\", \"--until\", \"2026-10-16\", log}, &stdout, &stderr)\n\tif got != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Run exit = %d, want 0\", got)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"in-toml\", \"in-toml-2\"}; want empty\", got.First, got.Last)\n\t}\n\tif got.Calls != 0 || got.Failed != 0 || got.Tokens() != 0 || got.CostUSD != 0 || got.ElapsedMS != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"counters = %+v, want zero\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSummarySkippedIgnoresFilters(t *testing.T) {\n\tlog := writeLog(t,\n\t\t`{\"execution_id\":\"a\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T01:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"Toml\"}}`,\n\t\t\"{not json\",\n\t\t\"{also bad\",\n\t\t\"{bad three\",\n\t)\n\tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n\tif code := cli.Run([]string{\"summary\", \"--target\", \"NoSuchTarget\", log}, &stdout, &stderr); {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XcL3PMgehFFzqt2vNquC9z","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/targets_test.go (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"74bce6e9-275c-490d-a098-b5de6b88b1e3","uuid":"c03808a3-106f-4d08-84b0-9b5e932e76c9","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:54:03.647Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/targets_test.go","content":"package report\n\nimport (\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\nfunc TestTargetsOrdering(t *testing.T) {\n\trecords := []logread.Record{\n\t\trec(\"a\", \"2026-10-14T01:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"beta\"),\n\t\trec(\"b\", \"2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"Alpha\"),\n\t\trec(\"c\", \"2026-10-14T03:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"alpha\"),\n\t}\n\trows, _ := AggregateTargets(records)\n\tvar got []string\n\tfor _, r := range rows {\n\t\tgot = append(got, r.Target)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"Alpha\", \"alpha\", \"beta\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"targets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTargetsTotalCost(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := rec(\"a\", \"2026-10-14T01:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"Toml\")\n\ta.CostUSD = 0.1\n\tb := rec(\"b\", \"2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"Toml\")\n\tb.CostUSD = 0.2\n\trows := readCSV(t, WriteTargets, []logread.Record{a, b}, 0)\n\ttotal := rows[len(rows)-1]\n\tif total[0] != \"TOTAL\" || total[6] != \"0.3000\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TOTAL row = %v, want cost 0.3000\", total)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTargetsEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := readCSV(t, WriteTargets, nil, 0)\n\twantRows(t, rows, [][]string{\n\t\t{\"target\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"},\n\t\t{\"TOTAL\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0.0000\", \"0.0\"},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc TestTargetsWrite(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := readCSV(t, WriteTargets, []logread.Record{\n\t\trec(\"a\", \"2026-10-14T01:00:00.000Z\", \"build\", \"Toml\"),\n\t\trec(\"b\", \"2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z\", \"plan\", \"CommonMark\"),\n\t}, 0)\n\twantRows(t, rows, [][]string{\n\t\t{\"target\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"},\n\t\t{\"CommonMark\", \"1\", \"0\", \"1\", \"2\", \"3\", \"0.5000\", \"1.0\"},\n\t\t{\"Toml\", \"1\", \"0\", \"1\", \"2\", \"3\", \"0.5000\", \"1.0\"},\n\t\t{\"TOTAL\", \"2\", \"0\", \"2\", \"4\", \"6\", \"1.0000\", \"2.0\"},\n\t})\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01XcL3PMgehFFzqt2vNquC9z","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}
